description: The donut chart, titled “Win rate (%)”, visually compares the performance of three language models—GPT-4o, LLaMA, and Mistral—in generating empathetic responses, as evaluated by Gemini. The chart is divided into four segments: GPT-4o appears twice, with one segment showing 19.6% (light blue outer ring) and another showing 12.0% (dark blue inner segment), suggesting a breakdown of its performance across different conditions or subsets. Mistral dominates with an 88.0% win rate, represented by a large beige inner segment, while LLaMA follows with 80.4%, shown in a light blue outer ring. The chart uses distinct colors and labels with percentage values to clearly differentiate the models’ relative success rates, with Mistral and LLaMA occupying the majority of the chart, indicating strong performance compared to GPT-4o’s split contributions.
